```{r dash-scorecard, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# ============================================================
# IDENTIFY CURRENT AND BASELINE RUNS
# ============================================================

scorecard_run_summary <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in%
      c("true", "yes", "1")
  ) %>%
  group_by(run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    sequence_num = first(sequence_num),
    users = n_distinct(user_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    tx_count = n(),
    pass_count = sum(is_pass, na.rm = TRUE),
    duration_secs = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),
    throughput = round(pass_count / duration_secs, 2),
    error_rate = round(
      sum(
        !tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in% c("true", "yes", "1"),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) / tx_count * 100,
      2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

current <- scorecard_run_summary %>%
  filter(sequence_num == max(sequence_num))

baseline <- scorecard_run_summary %>%
  filter(sequence_num == min(sequence_num))

current_run_id  <- current$run_id[1]
baseline_run_id <- baseline$run_id[1]

# ============================================================
# RT SLA PASS RATE
# ============================================================

current_rt <- get_run_rt_sla(current_run_id)
baseline_rt <- get_run_rt_sla(baseline_run_id)

current_rt_pass_rate <- NA
baseline_rt_pass_rate <- NA

if (!is.null(current_rt) &&
    current_rt$total_labels > 0) {

  current_rt_pass_rate <- round(
    (current_rt$passed_count /
      current_rt$total_labels) * 100,
    1
  )
}

if (!is.null(baseline_rt) &&
    baseline_rt$total_labels > 0) {

  baseline_rt_pass_rate <- round(
    (baseline_rt$passed_count /
      baseline_rt$total_labels) * 100,
    1
  )
}

# ============================================================
# TPS SLA PASS RATE
# ============================================================

get_tps_sla_pass_rate <- function(target_run_id) {

summary <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == target_run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in%
      c("true", "yes", "1")
  ) %>%
  group_by(app_name) %>%
  summarise(
    successful_transactions = sum(is_pass),
    duration_secs = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        max(timestamp),
        min(timestamp),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),
    throughput = ifelse(
      duration_secs > 0,
      successful_transactions / duration_secs,
      0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    target = get_app_tps_threshold(app_name),
    passed = throughput >= target
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

if (nrow(summary) == 0) {
  return(NA)
}

round(
  sum(summary$passed, na.rm = TRUE) /
    nrow(summary) * 100,
  2
)
}

current_tps_pass_rate <-
get_tps_sla_pass_rate(current_run_id)

baseline_tps_pass_rate <-
get_tps_sla_pass_rate(baseline_run_id)

# ============================================================
# ERROR SLA PASS RATE
# ============================================================

get_error_sla_pass_rate <- function(target_run_id) {

summary <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == target_run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in%
      c("true", "yes", "1")
  ) %>%
  group_by(app_name, thread_group) %>%
  summarise(
    transactions = n(),
    errors = sum(!is_pass, na.rm = TRUE),
    error_rate = round(
      errors / transactions * 100,
      2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    target = get_app_error_threshold(app_name),
    passed = error_rate <= target
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

if (nrow(summary) == 0) {
  return(NA)
}

round(
  sum(summary$passed, na.rm = TRUE) /
    nrow(summary) * 100,
  2
)
}

current_error_pass_rate <-
get_error_sla_pass_rate(current_run_id)

baseline_error_pass_rate <-
get_error_sla_pass_rate(baseline_run_id)

# ============================================================
# RESPONSE TIME
# ============================================================

rt_percentile <- 0.95

if (
  exists("rt_sla_config") &&
  !is.null(rt_sla_config$metric)
) {

  rt_percentile <- switch(
    tolower(rt_sla_config$metric),
    "p90" = 0.90,
    "p95" = 0.95,
    "p99" = 0.99,
    0.95
  )

}

current_rt_value <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    v = round(
      quantile(
        elapsed,
        rt_percentile,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(v)

baseline_rt_value <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == baseline_run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    v = round(
      quantile(
        elapsed,
        rt_percentile,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
              0
            )
          ) %>%
  pull(v)

# ============================================================
# DELTA HELPER
# ============================================================

delta_text <- function(current,
                      baseline,
                      lower_is_better = FALSE) {

  if (is.na(current) || is.na(baseline)) {
    return("—")
  }

  if (baseline == 0) {

    if (current == 0) {
      return("<span class='status-na'>▬ 0%</span>")
    }

    return(
      "<span class='status-fail'>▲ Increase</span>"
    )
  }

  delta <- round(
    ((current - baseline) / baseline) * 100,
    1
  )

  if (delta == 0) {
    return("<span class='status-na'>▬ 0%</span>")
  }

  if (lower_is_better) {

    if (delta < 0) {

      return(
        sprintf(
          "<span class='status-pass'>▼ %.1f%%</span>",
          abs(delta)
        )
      )
    }

    return(
      sprintf(
        "<span class='status-fail'>▲ %.1f%%</span>",
        delta
      )
    )
  }

  if (delta > 0) {

    return(
      sprintf(
        "<span class='status-pass'>▲ %.1f%%</span>",
        delta
      )
    )
  }

  sprintf(
    "<span class='status-fail'>▼ %.1f%%</span>",
    abs(delta)
  )
}

rt_metric_name <- "P95"

if (
exists("rt_sla_config") &&
!is.null(rt_sla_config$metric)
) {

rt_metric_name <- toupper(
  rt_sla_config$metric
)

}
```
